thread:
Maya (Recruiter): Quick sync — final onsite/hybrid loop for Carlos (SWE IC3) needs scheduling for Wed Mar 27. Candidate says mornings PT work best. We need: intro (30m), system design (60m), backend deep-dive (45m), manager (30m). Can the panel make a morning block?

TJ (Eng Manager): I can do 9:00–11:30 PT. Prefer earlier rather than late.

Alex (People Ops): I can cover 9:00–10:30 PT. timezone check — candidate is in EST (GMT-5) according to his reply.

Maya (Recruiter): Cool. Proposed start times: 9:00 PT (12:00 EST) or 10:00 PT (13:00 EST). Which works for everyone for a ~3h block?

TJ (Eng Manager): 9:00 PT works for me.

Alex (People Ops): 9:00 PT works. I'll reserve rooms and build the calendar invite.

Maya (Recruiter): Candidate replied: "9:00 PT is great, I'll join via Zoom — hybrid please. I'll be coming onsite for future roles but this one remote is fine. I can be on Zoom at 12:00 EST. Parking not needed."

Maya (Recruiter): Filing logistics: will send one calendar event with all interviewer invites + Zoom link. Onsite room fallback: conf-2 reserved 9:00–12:30 PT. Building access note (for future onsite): bring ID, enter via 3rd St lobby, ask reception for Redwood visitor badge.

Alex (People Ops): Draft invite (will paste into event):
```
Title: Redwood — Carlos (SWE IC3) — Final Loop
When: Wed Mar 27, 2024 09:00–12:00 PT
Location: Zoom (hybrid) / Conf-2 (3rd floor)
Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890?pwd=abc123
Agenda: 9:00 Intro (Maya/Alex) 9:30 System design (TJ) 10:30 Break 10:40 Backend deep-dive (Alex) 11:25 Manager (TJ)
Notes: Candidate remote. Please join 5m early.
```

Maya (Recruiter): Candidate asked about interview format — will be whiteboard-free except design (bring slides/code as needed) and asked if interviewers will share feedback promptly; we told him yes.

TJ (Eng Manager): One ask — can the design interviewer use a pad for drawing? I have a USB-C adapter.

Alex (People Ops): Noted. AV will have a whiteboard camera in conf-2 and a spare HDMI adapter in the AV drawer.

Maya (Recruiter): Sending invites now. I'll include Carlos' preferred pronouns and resume in the event and a short recruiter note with Zoom instructions.

SchedBot: Calendar invites sent to panel + candidate. Event ID: 9801-374.

Maya (Recruiter): Thanks all — will post final confirmation in thread once candidate accepts the invite. :thumbsup:

Carlos (Candidate): Confirmed — accepted the invite. See you (virtually) Wed at 12:00 EST.

TJ (Eng Manager): Great, thank you.

Alex (People Ops): Added a 15m debrief buffer after the manager loop for quick notes (12:00–12:15 EST / 09:00–09:15 PT).

Maya (Recruiter): Closing loop here. If anything changes I'll update thread.
